BusinessLimitSpecification.name: BusinessLimitSpecification
BusinessLimitSpecification.description: Represents a business limit and its metadata, including the context definition that maps a limit record to the limit framework.

ContextDefinitionName.description: The API name of the context definition associated with the business limit specification.

LimitSourceRecord.description: The Salesforce ID of the entity for which to trace the business limit.

Name.description: The autogenerated unique number of the record.

Status.description: The status of the business limit specification.

BusinessLimitSpecification.accessRules: BusinessLimitSpecification is only available in orgs where Global Promotions Management is enabled.
